ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (beige/white) to 55% low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity dark pigmentation dominates the central axial region and follows the trailing edge. Large contiguous high-intensity beige/white patches are located mid-lobe on both sides. The viewer-right lobe exhibits high-frequency dark mottling within the light patch, while the viewer-left patch is more uniform.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks and valleys (3-8 pixel amplitude) are consistent across both lobes, with a notable deeper notch on the viewer-left trailing edge approximately one-quarter distance from the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a slightly convex trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips, while the leading edge visible above the water line shows a concave sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark circular pixel clusters are detected at the extreme distal tips and along the leading edge margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel high-contrast (white) linear marks are visible on the low-intensity region of the viewer-left lobe. A single thin, horizontal linear mark is visible on the viewer-right low-intensity central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear rake marks on the central dark region; irregular notches along the trailing edge indicate localized tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform yellowish-beige pixel tinting across all high-intensity regions, contrasting with standard white pigmentation.
